commands.cmd:
d=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
timeout 120 uv venv --python 3.12 "$d/venv" >"$d/venv.log" 2>&1 || { echo "venv create failed"; tail -40 "$d/venv.log"; exit 1; }
timeout 240 uv pip install --python "$d/venv/bin/python" 'inspect-ai==0.3.266' 'openai' >"$d/install.log" 2>&1 || { echo "install failed"; tail -60 "$d/install.log"; exit 1; }
iv=$("$d/venv/bin/python" -c "import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version('inspect-ai'))")
[ "$iv" = "0.3.266" ] || { echo "unexpected inspect-ai version: $iv"; exit 1; }
KEYFILE=$(systemctl --user show nativestack-generation.service -p ExecStart --value | grep -oP -- '--api-key-file \K\S+')
[ -n "$KEYFILE" ] && [ -r "$KEYFILE" ] || { echo "generation service key file not found/readable"; exit 1; }
cat > "$d/task.py" <<'PYEOF'
from inspect_ai import Task, task
from inspect_ai.dataset import Sample
from inspect_ai.scorer import includes


@task
def tiny_local_eval():
    samples = [
        Sample(id="add", input="What is 7 plus 5? Reply with only the number, nothing else.", target="12"),
        Sample(id="capital", input="What is the capital of France? Reply with only the city name, nothing else.", target="Paris"),
        Sample(id="reverse", input="Spell the word cat backwards. Reply with only the result, nothing else.", target="tac"),
        Sample(id="wrong_target_control", input="What is 2 plus 2? Reply with only the number, nothing else.", target="5"),
    ]
    return Task(dataset=samples, scorer=includes())
PYEOF
echo "resolved inspect-ai: $iv | task file: $d/task.py"
key=$(cat "$KEYFILE")
( cd "$d" && LLAMACPP_API_KEY="$key" timeout 150 ./venv/bin/inspect eval task.py \
  --model openai-api/llamacpp/qwen3.8-27b-local \
  --model-base-url http://127.0.0.1:18232/v1 \
  --temperature 0 --max-tokens 192 \
  --log-dir logs --log-format json --display none --no-log-realtime ) >"$d/eval.out" 2>&1
rc=$?
tail -15 "$d/eval.out"
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || { echo "inspect eval exited $rc"; exit 1; }
LOG=$(ls "$d"/logs/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)
[ -n "$LOG" ] || { echo "no log produced"; exit 1; }
python3 -c "
import json, sys
data = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
assert data['status'] == 'success', data['status']
scores = {s['id']: s['scores']['includes']['value'] for s in data['samples']}
acc = data['results']['scores'][0]['metrics']['accuracy']['value']
print('status:', data['status'], '| accuracy:', acc, '| per-sample scores:', scores)
ok = (acc == 0.75 and scores.get('add') == 'C' and scores.get('capital') == 'C'
      and scores.get('reverse') == 'C' and scores.get('wrong_target_control') == 'I')
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
" "$LOG"
assert_rc=$?
[ "$assert_rc" -eq 0 ] && rm -rf "$d"
exit "$assert_rc"
